rule_or_requirement: A pixel-only driver needs valid finishes before lap-time optimization, including after temporary road visibility loss.
observable_information: Four grayscale pixel frames, detected road rows, pixel-estimated speed, offcenter asphalt, inherited action and reset-local memory.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Four separately registered low-visibility steering, speed, reacquisition or asphalt-boundary interventions around the frozen driver.
expected_success_endpoint: At least one activated candidate preserves every control finish and improves completion-first matched TRAIN metrics on six fresh cells.
control: Exact bend-rebound ZIP SHA-256 8f7e87c29e92caf49db0070842dbc30f21a20ff98a3f48bf17d9599490559e49, evaluated on every same cell.
falsifier: Any invalid action, fewer than three changed actions per mechanism, a candidate-only lost control finish, or no completion-first/time improvement.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Five arms × tracks 1–3 × fresh TRAIN seeds 7400–7401, 30 closed-loop episodes.
resource_and_risk_gate: Linux Docker CPU 1,200 seconds, two cores, 2 GiB, 650 decisions/episode; identical six fresh TRAIN cells, no reserved split or external action.
